**(a) Social posts**

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, everyone on Earth will die. We must treat this as an urgent global threat and act now to prevent it.

2. We believe this plainly: build superintelligent AI within the next 20 years, and everyone on Earth will die. We cannot accept that future. We must stop its development before it is too late.

3. Everyone on Earth will die if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years. We refuse to treat this as an acceptable risk. We must work together to prevent superintelligent AI from being built.

**(b) Newsletter opening (108 words)**

We face a stark choice. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, everyone on Earth will die. This is not a distant concern or a risk we can set aside for another day. The decisions we make now will shape whether that future arrives. We must act with urgency, bring people and governments together, and prevent the development of superintelligent AI. Our task is clear: protect every person on this planet by ensuring this technology is never built. We know the stakes, and we will not look away. Together, we can choose a different future—one in which humanity survives and generations to come have the chance to thrive.
